source: Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) American Time Use Survey (ATUS) Summary Tables (Table A-1)
status: Reference only. The atus_daily_hours_reference values are NOT used in decisions.
note: contracts.get_prior loads this file into ATUS_PRIORS_META and never reads the hours. Decisions use a flat base weight of 1 for every action plus the urgency boosts below, which are hand-set, not measured. The seven survival actions are not ATUS categories, so the hours are a hand mapping and have not been checked against the published table.
description: ATUS reference hours mapped by hand to the 7 survival actions, plus the hand-set weights contracts.get_prior does use.
